enquiry.title: Enquiry
enquiry.summary: Someone filled in a form on a public website
enquiry.description: What a website visitor sends before anyone knows who they are. Holds their own words and contact details as typed. No client or pipeline is attached, because neither exists yet. Sales reads it and converts it into a client, a contact and a lead. Kept separate from lead on purpose. A lead is a deal with a value and a stage, and counting unqualified website traffic as deals makes every pipeline report wrong.

convert.description: Turn the enquiry into a client, a contact and a lead. Authorization: a member of the sales group.

markSpam.description: Drop the enquiry as spam. Authorization: a member of the sales group.

close.description: Close the enquiry without a lead, because it is answered or not worth one. Authorization: a member of the sales group.

search.description: Search website enquiries, optionally filtered by lifecycle status, intake source, or the organisation the submitter named. Returns RBAC-scoped enquiry summaries, newest first.

get.description: Get a single website enquiry by id, including the submitter's contact details and the message they wrote.

title.description: Short summary of the enquiry, shown in the sales inbox (schema:name)
title.title: Title

contactName.description: Name of the person who sent the enquiry, as they typed it
contactName.title: Contact name

contactEmail.description: Email address the submitter gave. Usually the only way to answer them
contactEmail.title: Contact email

contactPhone.description: Phone number the submitter gave, if the form asked for one
contactPhone.title: Contact phone

organisation.description: Organisation the submitter says they represent. Typed by them, never verified
organisation.title: Organisation

message.description: The submitter's own words, kept verbatim
message.title: Message

source.description: Which form the enquiry came from, for example website-support or website-contact. Set by the intake endpoint from its own allowlist, not by the submitter
source.title: Source

pageUrl.description: Page the form was on. Says what the visitor was reading when they asked
pageUrl.title: Page URL

locale.description: Language the visitor was reading in, so the reply goes out in the same one
locale.title: Locale

receivedAt.description: When the intake endpoint accepted the enquiry. Written by the server, never by the submitter
receivedAt.title: Received at

status.description: Where the enquiry stands. Starts at new and is moved by the sales group
status.title: Status

client.description: UUID reference to the client created when this enquiry was converted
client.title: Client

contact.description: UUID reference to the contact created when this enquiry was converted
contact.title: Contact

lead.description: UUID reference to the lead created when this enquiry was converted
lead.title: Lead

handledBy.description: Nextcloud user who converted, closed or rejected the enquiry
handledBy.title: Handled by

handledAt.description: When the enquiry left the new state
handledAt.title: Handled at
